label: MA5801-FL16 OLT
description: Huawei OptiXaccess MA5801-FL16, the Flex-PON member of the MA5801 family: the same 1U box and the same 4 GE/10GE upstream SFP+ ports, but each of its 16 service ports can be provisioned as GPON (2.5G downstream), XGS-PON (10G) or a GPON+XGS-PON combo, and the switching capacity rises to 460 Gbit/s. Modelled as one PON port that accepts either rate, because the hardware decides at provisioning time which of the three it is - a port pinned to one rate is a software choice, not a different box. Combo mode carries both wavelengths on one port simultaneously; this model carries the rate, not the second wavelength. Requested in #198; figures from Huawei's MA5801 specification table.
